adaptations: Original Pine entry uses stop=BBlower and cancels the resting order if the condition fails. Apex uses a completed-bar signal and a market order only after operator authorization.
Added independent protective stop at 1.5 x ATR14 Wilder below entry.
Added 4-hour maximum hold, $25 notional, one position, five entries/day, $5 daily loss cutoff.
No shorting, no leverage, no averaging down.

frozenRules.entry: same completed candle: RSI crosses above 50 and close crosses above lower band
frozenRules.exit: same completed candle: RSI crosses below 50 and close crosses below upper band
